display.name: MotherDuck
display.summary: Inspects MotherDuck schemas and runs read-only SQL queries against the signed-in workspace data.
examples: Show monthly active users for the last six months.
Compare support volume by customer segment this quarter.

connection.note: Sign in with the MotherDuck account that can access the database you want Rytangle to read. The catalog exposes read-only tools.

agent.name: motherduck
agent.description: Explores the signed-in MotherDuck workspace and runs read-only SELECT queries for business analytics. It does not modify tables, schemas, or data.
agent.owns: You own the MotherDuck databases and schemas the signed-in account can read. Use list_databases and search_catalog to discover available data, then use query for read-only analysis. You cannot insert, update, delete, create, or alter data because the write-capable query_rw tool is intentionally excluded. You do not own other databases or the source repository. Include the SQL query and relevant MotherDuck link when available.

tool_descriptions.list_databases: Lists the MotherDuck databases available to the authenticated account.
tool_descriptions.search_catalog: Searches the MotherDuck catalog for databases, schemas, tables, and other data objects.
tool_descriptions.ask_docs_question: Answers a focused question using MotherDuck and DuckDB documentation.
tool_descriptions.query: Runs a read-only SQL SELECT query against MotherDuck and returns the result with the executed SQL.
